subject: Device onboarding: staging capacity, shipping ops and vendor transition
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Device onboarding: staging capacity, shipping ops and vendor transition

Team —

We need to firm up the device onboarding plan for the upcoming batch of ~120 laptops (Mix: 60 MacBook Pro 14\", 60 ThinkPad X1). Key asks before I loop procurement/finance: 

- Confirm staging capacity at BoxRunner (kitting, imaging, label application, QA). Target dates: staging complete by Oct 6, shipping complete by Oct 12.
- Shipping SLA: guaranteed 48-hour domestic transit, insurance options.
- Telecom porting for 30 hotdesk lines with TeliaPort — any blackout windows?
- WorkHub co-working seat credits for relocated teams — need draft agreement and credit description.

Neha: can you confirm budget code and whether we run this through the existing supplier or open it for a 1-week competitive check?
Dev: any special imaging/config needs (VPN cert, internal MDM profiles) that affect staging time?
Monica: please prepare the PO template and vendor onboarding checklist.

I'll start the vendor introductions to BoxRunner and WorkHub after we confirm slots.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: BoxRunner Logistics <ops@boxrunner.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Device onboarding: staging capacity, shipping ops and vendor transition

Hi Rishi / Neha —

Thanks for reaching out. We can handle the full kitting + imaging + multi-drop shipping for 120 units in the window you outlined. Summary below: 

- Staging capacity: 150 units/week at our SFO facility (can scale to 220/week with 48-hr advance notice).
- Typical SLA: 48-hour staging turnaround from receipt; domestic courier 1-2 business days.
- Insurance: $2500 coverage standard; excess coverage available at additional premium (see attached rate card).
- Imaging: we support PXE/TFTP and ThinKiosk workflows, 2-stage QA (hardware & imaging).
- Shipping labels: We can print client-provided labels or use our manifesting.

Attachment: staging_rate_card.pdf (rate table, insurance, expedited options).

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min ops call next week to walk the checklist and timelines.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Operations Lead, BoxRunner Logistics
ops@boxrunner.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks Rishi — quick technical notes from my side: 

- Imaging: we'll need to seed the corporate MDM profile and install the VPN cert during staging. BoxRunner confirmed they can run our PXE sequence — I'll share the image manifest by Monday.
- Asset tagging: prefer tamper-evident barcode tags (format: RWD-#####). BoxRunner: confirm you can adhere to that template.
- Hotdesk telecom: TeliaPort — we need porting dates aligned to the WorkHub location cutover (target Oct 15). Can TeliaPort confirm any known maintenance windows in mid-Oct?

Also — WorkHub: is the co-working credit model per seat per month or a lump sum credit applied at invoice? We need the credit to apply to the month following move-in.

Dev
Sr. Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi / team —

Appreciate the outline. We can provide a bulk seat credit for the first 3 months (credit applied monthly, not as a lump sum) for up to 50 seats. Draft agreement attached for your legal review (workhub_agreement_draft.docx). Highlights: 

- Credit: 100% seat credit month 1 for up to 50 seats; 50% credit month 2; 25% credit month 3.
- Billing: credits applied as line-item adjustments on monthly invoice.
- Move-in: we can support Oct 15 onboarding and will coordinate with TeliaPort for desk-level provisioning.

Next steps: confirm PO and send signed agreement; we will provision seat reservations and calendar holds.

Appreciate the quick responses — putting the plan into motion now. Action items: 

1) Procurement will issue PO PO-R-2931 (attached) to BoxRunner for staging + ship + insurance. Expected net 30.
2) WorkHub: please mark 50 seat credits and return signed agreement by EOD Sep 20 so we can finalize the invoice adjustments for Oct.
3) TeliaPort: confirm porting blackout windows and send the porting checklist. We need desk-level provisioning completed by Oct 14 to avoid any move-day delays.
4) Dev: once BoxRunner confirms they can apply RWD- barcode tags and import MDM seed, share the final image manifest.

Attachments: PO-R-2931.pdf (purchase order), I will route this through finance and CC procurement.

If there are any blockers I haven't captured, call me. Otherwise I'll schedule the ops sync (30 min) for Wed 9/16 10am PT.
